title: Omnia native state-revision graph read v1
description: The bounded, content-free Tauri IPC projection returned by state_revision_graph_read. This is a runtime read contract, not an instance of the richer portable state-revision-graph export schema. The native kernel resolves the branch and fixed watermark from one SQLite snapshot, clamps an over-large watermark to available facts, signs process-bound continuation cursors, and redacts manifests, authority, routing/cache, actors and diagnostics.

streamId.description: Native state-revision stream identifier for the selected profile, conversation and branch.

conversationId.description: Conversation scope revalidated by native storage.

branchId.description: Branch scope revalidated by native storage.

acceptedHeadStateRevisionId.description: Latest accepted revision visible at throughBranchSequence. Null means that no accepted revision is visible at the selected watermark; acceptedHeadBranchSequence is then the zero sentinel. This includes an empty stream and candidate-only or otherwise non-accepted history.

acceptedHeadBranchSequence.description: Branch sequence of acceptedHeadStateRevisionId in this bounded read.

throughBranchSequence.description: Resolved inclusive branch-sequence watermark. Native storage clamps a requested value to the highest fact in the pinned SQLite snapshot.

revisions.description: Redacted immutable revision summaries at or before throughBranchSequence, ordered by branch sequence and identifier.

edges.description: Redacted causal edges whose source and target revisions are both visible in the bounded read. Edge direction is child/derived fact (fromStateRevisionId) to source/parent fact (toStateRevisionId).

integrity.description: Coarse native projection health. Detailed graph diagnostics are intentionally not exposed by this v1 IPC contract.

revisionsHasMore.description: True when a signed continuation cursor can retrieve more revisions at the same fixed watermark.

edgesHasMore.description: True when a signed continuation cursor can retrieve more edges at the same fixed watermark.

nextRevisionsCursor.description: Process-bound native continuation cursor for the next revision page; null when the page is complete.

nextEdgesCursor.description: Process-bound native continuation cursor for the next edge page; null when the page is complete.

revisionsLimit.description: Effective native page size for revision projections.

edgesLimit.description: Effective native page size for edge projections.

responseBytes.description: UTF-8 serialized response size in bytes, including continuation metadata.

stateDigest.description: Redacted digest value; algorithm and canonicalization metadata are intentionally omitted from this projection.

parentStateRevisionIds.description: Visible parent identifiers after native branch-sequence filtering.
